summary: The Server/Application State Protocol lets load balancers and workload managers communicate better ways to spread work across a group of systems. Work distributors usually know little about how well applications can finish work, and health monitors have little control over how much arrives. SASP bridges that gap. This memo is informational.

eli5.summary: A person handing out jobs does not know who is tired. This protocol lets the workers tell the job-giver how busy they are, so jobs are shared more fairly.
